auth_sign_in_subtitle: Svika munzvimbo yako yebasa yechipatara zvakachengeteka.
auth_welcome_back_body: Saina kuti ugadzirise varwere, inventory, kugadzwa, uye kufambiswa kwebasa rekiriniki kuchikwata chako.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Gadzira account yekutarisira varwere, hesitori, kugadzwa, uye kiriniki workflows yechikwata chako.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Isa iyo email kuaccount yako. Isu tichatumira reset link kana inoenderana nemushandisi akanyoreswa.
auth_check_email_body: Kana {email} yakanyoreswa, reset link iri munzira. Iyo link inopera mumaminitsi gumi nemashanu.
auth_otp_subtitle: Isu takatumira 6-manhamba kodhi ku{email}. Inopera mumaminitsi gumi.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Isa iyo 6-manhamba kodhi kubva kune yako authenticator app.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Simbisa password yako kuti ugadzire QR kodhi yechokwadi.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Skena neapp yako yechokwadi, wobva waisa iyo 6-manhamba kodhi.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Chengetedza macode aya kumwe kwakachengeteka. Imwe neimwe kodhi inogona kushandiswa kamwe chete.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Isa password yako kuti udzime mbiri-factor authentication.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Tsiva chibatiso chako. Zvishandiso zviripo zvinomira kushanda kudzamara watarisa QR itsva.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Simbisa password yako kuti utsive QR kodhi yako yechokwadi.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Isa password yako. Macode ekare ekuchengetedza achamira kushanda.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Macode matsva agadzirira. Vaponese pane imwe nzvimbo yakachengeteka.
session_extend_description: Simbisa password yako kuti uwedzere mamwe maawa maviri pachikamu chino.
session_extend_password_hint: Isa password yeakaundi yawakapinda nayo. Unogona kuwedzera kamwe chete pachikamu.
session_extend_already_extended: Ichi chikamu chakange chatowedzerwa kamwe chete.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Panguva yekuseta iwe unogona kutarisisa iyo QR imwechete neinodarika mudziyo mumwe.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Huviri-zvinhu huchokwadi hunodiwa pane ichi chiito. Zvigadzirise kuti uenderere mberi.
enter_email_reset_description: Isa email yako uye tichakutumira chinongedzo chekuseta patsva password yako.
invalid_reset_link: Link yekuseta patsva haigoneki kana kupera nguva. Ndokumbirawo mukumbire itsva pazasi.
password_min_length: Password inofanira kunge iine mavara masere.
reset_email_sent: Kana account iripo yeiyi email, password reset link yatumirwa.
password_reset_success: Password reset zvinobudirira. Wava kugona kupinda.

op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Bhiri iri rakadhindwa; iyo yekushanya-level discount haigone kuchinjwa.

op_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Nursing yakakwana haina kupera; bhiri harigone kuvharwa.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Hapana masevhisi apera akamirira kubhadhariswa kwekushanya uku.

op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Pedzisa hukoti hwakakwana kune ese mitsara yebasa usati wavhara.
ip_billing_select_visit_hint: Sarudza kushanya kuti utange IP kubhadharisa.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Bhiri iri rakadhindwa; iyo yekushanya-level discount haigone kuchinjwa.
ip_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Nursing yakakwana haina kupera; bhiri harigone kuvharwa.
ip_billing_no_services_found: Hapana masevhisi anobhadhariswa awanikwa pakushanya uku.
no_hospital_assigned: Hapana chipatara chakapihwa account yako. Bata maneja wako.
no_hospitals_yet: Hapasati pave nezvipatara. Gadzira imwe kuti utange.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Hapasati pave nezvipatara. Bata maneja wako kuti utange.
hospital_coding_system_help: Inosungira chipatara ichi kune imwechete WHO yekuongorora kodhi chiyero. Haikwanise kuchinja mushure mekuongororwa kwekodhi.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Coding system yakavharwa nekuti chipatara ichi chatove nemacode ekuongorora.
hospital_coding_release_unknown: Hapana WHO katalogi yekutumira yakanyorwa parizvino.
icd_who_attribution: ICD-10 uye ICD-11 zvirimo ndeye World Health Organisation (WHO). ICD-11 ine rezinesi pasi peCC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Kushandisa kunoda kupihwa; kugadzirisa kunoda mvumo yeWHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Chipatara chega chega chinosunga imwe WHO diagnostic coding system (ICD-10 kana ICD-11 MMS) panguva yekugadzira. EMR kuongororwa kutsvaga inoshandisa iyo catalog chete. Mabhuku akazara anotengeswa kunze kwenyika kuburikidza neWHO ICD-API mune yakagovaniswa master tafura.
name: Zita
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Hapasati pave nezvipatara. Gadzira imwe uye sunga muridzi.
admin_team_subtitle: Koka vabatsiri uye sarudza mapeji e admin avanogona kushandisa.
admin_team_empty: Hapana nhengo dzechikwata che admin parizvino.
admin_team_need_view: Peji imwe chete inofanira kuva nemvumo yekuona.
admin_team_invite_hint: Ivo vanogashira password reset email kuseta yavo password.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Kutarisa kunodiwa usati wagadzira, kugadzirisa, kana kudzima pane peji.
admin_team_reset_failed: Hatina kukwanisa kutumira password reset email.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Kushandiswa, chiitiko chazvino, uye hutano hwe database.
admin_staff_subtitle: Vese vashandisi vane basa revashandi muzvipatara zvese.
admin_ops_subtitle: Kurarama kushandiswa, zvichangobva kuitika, uye hutano hwe database.
admin_ops_load_error: Hatina kukwanisa kurodha zviitwa uye data rehutano.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Zvirongwa uye zvichangoburwa zvinogadzira kubva kune mhenyu dhatabhesi.
admin_ops_db_subtitle: Mamiriro ekubatanidza uye kuchengetedza kubva kuPostgreSQL.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Ronga quota haina kuburitswa kuburikidza neSQL. Ona Neon console yekuchengetedza iripo.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Saizi yedatabase inobva kuPostgreSQL pg_database_size (saizi inonzwisisika pane iyi Neon bazi).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Neon chirongwa chekuchengetedza quota haisi kuwanikwa kuburikidza neSQL. Inoshandiswa vs inowanikwa inoda iyo Neon console kana Neon API.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Table row counts is live COUNT(*) pama core tables, kwete pg_stat estimates.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Kutsvaga kwekubatanidza kwatadza. Tarisa DATABASE_URL uye Neon mamiriro ebazi.
no_owners_yet: Hapana varidzi parizvino. Gadzira imwe yekuvabvumidza kupinda muzvipatara.
no_user_groups_yet: Hapana mapoka evashandisi parizvino. Gadzira imwe yekupa vashandi.
no_user_groups_create: Hapana mapoka evashandisi. Gadzira imwe pamusoro.
no_branches_yet: Hapana mapazi parizvino. Wedzera bazi rechipatara ichi.
no_user_groups: Hapana mapoka evashandisi aripo pachipatara ichi.
user_groups_optional_hint: Sarudza rimwe kana akawanda mapoka evashandisi (optional).
store_central_help: Kakawanda pabazi rimwe chete. GRN inotumira zvinhu muchitoro ichi. Kana uchitova nechitoro chepakati pabazi iri, chidzima ipapo usati wagonesa pano.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: USB scanners inowanzotaipa mumunda wakatarisa. Kuongorora kwekamera kunogona kuwedzerwa gare gare.
item_master_batch_required_help: Kana yagoneswa, risiti yemidziyo inofanirwa kusanganisira nhamba yebhetch, zuva rekupera, uye mutengo wekutenga wechinhu ichi (chaiyo kuchitoro chemishonga).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Sarudza chinhu chekutanga, wobva washandisa Default kuenderana neshanduko dzinoisanganisira.
Hapana yuniti inoshandura inoshandisa chinhu ichi unit pakutenga kana kuburitsa.
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Sarudza default pakati peakasanganisirwa unit shanduko.
item_master_category_hint: Chete General Supply, Pharmacy Supply, kana Medical Supply (kubva Category Master).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Sarudza pharmacy generic yezvinhu zvePharmacy Supply.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Hapana mageneric emu pharmacy. Gadzira imwe pamusoro.
unit_master_empty: Hapana mayunitsi parizvino. Gadzira imwe pamusoro.
item_unit_master_purchase_factor: Kutenga chinhu (chigadziko pachikamu chimwe chete chekutenga)
no_item_unit_profiles: Hapasati pava nekushandurwa. Gadzira imwe pamusoro.
confirm_delete_refer: Une chokwadi chekuti unoda kudzima referensi iyi?
support_unauthorized: Iwe unofanirwa kusaina kuti ushandise rutsigiro.
nursing_case_sheet_save_success: Pepa renyaya rakachengetwa kune zvakanamirwa nemurwere.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Tatadza kuchengetedza nyaya kune zvakanamirwa nemurwere.
clinical_document_save_failed: Tatadza kuchengetedza fomu kune zvakanamirwa nemurwere.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Sarudza kushanya uchishandisa 'Sarudza Kushanya' bhatani riri pamusoro kuti uone shizha renyaya.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Sarudza kushanya uchishandisa bhatani re'Sarudza Kushanya' pamusoro kuti uone data yekutarisa.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Kushanya uku kwakachengetwa sekusainwa. Kuona uye kugadzirisa kweCPOE kunodzimwa kusvika wasarudza kumwe kushanya.
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Sevha kushanya uku sekusainwa? Izvi hazvigone kugadziriswa. Kutarisa uye kugadzirisa kweCPOE kuchadzimwa pakushanya uku; nursing workbench inogara iripo.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Chirongwa Chekuchengetedza hachiwanikwe mune ino kuvaka. Shandisa chirongwa chemukoti EMR chekutarisira kana chagadzirira.
observation_emr_casesheet_coming: Iyi module iri kuuya munguva pfupi.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_not_found: Icho chirongwa chekuchengetedza rekodhi haina kuwanikwa.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Zvinyorwa zvekufambira mberi hazviwanikwe mune ino kuvaka. Shandisa zvinyorwa zvemukoti EMR kana yagadzirira.
observation_emr_progress_note_empty: Hapana zvinyorwa zvekufambira mberi kwekushanya uku.
observation_emr_progress_note_not_found: Chinyorwa ichocho chekufambira mberi hachina kuwanikwa.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Nyora mirairo yekurapa, mishonga, dosi, uye zano kumurwere…
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Mutsetse uyu uri pamubhadharo wakavharwa weOP uye haugone kupepetwa kana kumiswa.
observation_emr_vital_inactivate_message: Ita kuti rekodhi yakakosha kubva ku{date}?
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Mutsetse wekuodha uyu uchanzi haushande uye unobviswa paOP yekubhadharisa.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Nyorazve tsananguro yekupinda pazasi kuti isashande ichi chinyorwa.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Izvi zvichabvisa account yavo uye havachakwanisa kusaina.
service_item_select_category_sub_categor: Ndapota sarudza chikamu uye chikamu chiduku.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Zvidimbu zvinosanganiswa kuti zvigadzire kodhi yega yega. Wedzera zvakagadziriswa zvinyorwa, data data, uye nhamba inomhanya.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Wedzera kanenge chidimbu chimwe chete kune iyo kodhi fomati.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Fomati yakachengetwa yatadza kurodha; kutanga kubva kune yakasarudzika marongerwo.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Seta kuti macode evarwere, nhamba dzekushanya, uye nhamba dzekuodha sevhisi zvinogadzirwa sei. Chinangwa chega chega chinoshandisa yakagadziriswa system kiyi; unongoshandura tsananguro nefomati.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Inoshandiswa pakunyoresa varwere vatsva. Mhando yekushanya haipo pakodhi iyi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Inoshandiswa pakushanya kwemurwere wega wega; inosanganisira bazi uye mhando yekushanyira kana minda iyo iri mufomati.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Inoshandiswa pakugadzira mirairo yebasa. Default fomati inoenderana neYY/shanya/NNN. Batidza "Kupatsanura kutevedzana pakushanya" kuti nhamba dzemaodha dziverenge 001, 002… pakushanya kwemurwere (kunokurudzirwa). Kana yakadzimwa, kutevedzana kunogovaniswa kune ese maodha anoshandisa akafanana mamwe masikopu.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Inoshandiswa pakugadzira zvinodiwa kutenga (PR). Gadzirisa izvi vashandi vasati vagadzira PRs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Inoshandiswa pakugadzira mirairo yekutenga (PO). Gadzirisa izvi vashandi vasati vagadzira maPO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Inoshandiswa pakugadzira indents yedhipatimendi. Gadzirisa izvi vashandi vasati vagadzira ma indents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Inoshandiswa pakugadzira nyaya dzedhipatimendi kubva pakati kuenda kuzvitoro zvekukumbira.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Inoshandiswa paunenge uchiendesa magwaro ekushandiswa kwedhipatimendi kuti atenderwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Inoshandiswa paunenge uchichengetedza mirairo yemishonga yemukati. Mitsetse yese mune imwe save share iyi batch number. Default inoshandisa gore remari, chipatara, uye inoteedzana inoteedzana.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Sarudza kuti ndezvipi zviyero zvinopatsanura nhamba inomhanya. Chiratidziro chiri pamusoro apa chakaparadzana; izvi zvinongokanganisa kuti mangani akazvimirira akatevedzana aunowana.
inv_grn_api_hint: Gadzira maGRN kuburikidza nePOST ine poId, storeId (pakati), yakagamuchirwaDate, uye mitsetse. Mutsara wega wega: poLineId, yakatengwaQty (isina mahara), batchNo, expiryDate, buyPrice (inodiwa kana chinhu chine batch tracking). Mabheti akajairwa (item_batch); stock ndeye pachitoro uye batch (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Rongedza mazinga emvumo nevanopihwa zvechitoro nemhando yegwaro raunosarudza pamusoro.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Mhinduro dzekutsvaga dzinosanganisira pane-ruoko pane yakasarudzwa (kubva) chitoro chete (yenyaya unit kana iripo).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: Ona inovhura risiti iri papeji rayo; Kudzoka kunodzoka pano (kwete kune Dhipatimendi nyaya).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Mitsara inoti `inv_stock` yakabatanidzwa ku `item_batch`, yakarongwa nekupera kwenguva (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Sefa mapoka evashandisi nemazita kana id...
inv_user_groups_no_filter_match: Hapana mapoka evashandisi anoenderana nesefa iyi.
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Isa huwandu hwakatenderwa pamutsetse kana uchifanira kusiyana newakakumbirwa. Yakamirira PR qty inokwana mitsetse kubva kune ino yekukumbira chitoro (yakamirira, kudzoserwa, kana kubvumidzwa), kusanganisira ichi chinodiwa.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Hapasati pave nezvinhu. Dzvanya + kuti uwedzere chinhu, wozochengeta odha.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Sarudza chikumbiro chekutenga chakatenderwa pamusoro. Tafura inotakura pano nemutsara wega wega: chinhu, yuniti (Item Unit Master shanduko), yasara huwandu, huwandu hwekurongeka, uye mutengo weyuniti.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Sarudza chinhu kutanga, wobva wasarudza iyo unit (shanduko) kubva pane iyo Item Unit Master runyorwa.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Chinhu ichi hachina shanduko yeyuniti. Vagadzirise pasi peInventory setup → Item master.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Sarudza chitoro chepakati chekutenga mubhawa yepamusoro. Zvikumbiro zvinotenderwa zveodha nyowani yekutenga zvinongonyorwa chete kana chitoro ichocho chasarudzwa-zvinotumirwa kunotenga pakati, kwete kune zvimwe zvitoro zvakaita sechitoro chemishonga isiri iyo CPS yakagadziriswa.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Gadzirisa chitoro chepakati chekutenga pasi peInventory setup → Chipatara inventory gadziriso usati wagadzira maodha ekutenga kubva kune zvinodikanwa.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Vhara iyi PO line womaka yasara qty seyakavharwa?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Vhara iyi PR mutsara wasara qty (set open-for-PO kusvika 0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Hapana chitoro chepakati chakagadzirirwa bazi rekutenga odha iyi. Risiti yemidziyo inofanira kuiswa mudura rebazi. MuInventory setup, maka chaizvo chitoro chimwe chete pabazi sepakati (chiri chepakati chitoro), wozoedza zvakare.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Sarudza odha yekutenga kuti uone chitoro chiri kugamuchira.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Nhamba yeBatch, kupera, uye mutengo wekutenga unodiwa pazvinhu zvakatevedzwa.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Sarudza zvakawanda kubva mudura rechitoro, kana kurodha mijenya mushure mekusarudza zvitoro.
inv_hub_subtitle: Kutenga, stock, uye mafambiro echipatara ichi.
inv_hub_card_po: Gadzira uye bvumidza maodha ekutenga, tumira kune mutengesi.
inv_hub_card_grn: Rekodha risiti yezvinhu uchipikisa maodha ekutenga.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Kutenga kwepakati kunopihwa pasi peChipatara heta config.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, uye GRN yezvinhu zvakatengwa shandisa chitoro ichi. Chitoro chakasarudzwa chakanyorwa seCentral kutenga; yekutanga inodzokera kuRegular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Kana mutsara wakazara pakutenga odha (s), yakavhurika huwandu ndeye 0 pano; track yakarairwa, yakagamuchirwa, uye ichiri-ku-kugashira paPO neGRN skrini.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Maodha ekutenga aripo ePR iyi asi mazita haana kurodha. Edza kumutsiridza peji.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Iyo yepamusoro bar inoisa yako hesera / kukumbira (kubva) chitoro. Rondedzero yacho inoratidza zvikumbiro zvakasimudzwa nechitoro ichocho. Sarudza Zvitoro zvese kuti uone zvinodikanwa kubva kune yega yega chitoro chinokumbira, kana shandisa chitoro mbiru sefa kutetepa neKubva kuchitoro.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Stock inogumira kuchitoro mubhawa yepamusoro. Sarudza Zvese zvitoro kuti uone chitoro chese muchipatara.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Rondedzero yacho inongogumira kune indents yakasimudzwa nechitoro mubhawa yepamusoro. Sarudza Zvese zvitoro kuti uone ese madhipatimendi indents.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Gadzira chinodiwa chekutenga kubva kuchitoro chiri kukumbira (yepamusoro bar) → mushure memvumo, gadzira odha yekutenga uye utumire GRN muchitoro chekugamuchira → pane GRN runyorwa, shandisa Transfer kuendesa stock yakagamuchirwa kuchitoro chakavhura requisition (kana PR yakabatana nePO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kubva kuchitoro kunobva kumusoro bar. Sarudza Yekuchengeta kune ichi chikumbiro.
inv_flow_po_context: MaPO echitoro chakasarudzwa (yepamusoro bar) tevera zvinodiwa zvekutenga zvakabvumidzwa kana kupinda nemaoko; bvumidza wotumira kune mutengesi usati watambirwa zvinhu.
inv_flow_grn_context: Tumira marisiti muchitoro chekugamuchira (top bar). Kana iyo PO yakabatana nechikumbiro, shandisa Transfer kutumira stock kuchitoro chekukumbira mushure mekutumira GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Sarudza chitoro chiri mubhawa repamusoro kuti utarise runyorwa urwu, kana kushandisa Ese maodha ekutenga muchipatara kana pasina chitoro chakasarudzwa.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Chitoro chepakati (top bar = Kubva kuchitoro) chinomutsa nyaya kuzvitoro zvinokumbira: zvingave kubva kudhipatimendi rakatenderwa rakamirira kuzadzikiswa, kana nemaoko pasina indent.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Semaodha ekutenga: shandisa Nyowani kubva kudhipatimendi indent kana stock yakumbirwa kuchitoro chako chepakati kuburikidza neindent; shandisa Manual kana pasina indent.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Shandura iyo "Kubva kuchitoro" kutonga mubhari yepamusoro (padyo nebazi / boka revashandisi) kana chikamu cheInventory chavhurwa.
inv_dept_issue_no_pending_indents: Hapana ma indents akamirira chitoro ichi.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Aya ma indents anotenderwa nechitoro chiri kukumbira uye akamirira kuti iwe uvhure nyaya yedhipatimendi. Sarudza chitoro chepakati mubhawa yepamusoro.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Gadzira nyaya yedhipatimendi kubva kuInventory → Nyaya yedhipatimendi → Nyowani kubva kudhipatimendi indent (pakati pechitoro chinofanira kuenderana nechitoro ichi "ku" mubhawa yepamusoro).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Sarudza chepakati (kuzadza) chitoro mubhawa yepamusoro. Rondedzero yacho inoratidza nyaya uko chitoro icho chiri kupa (Kubva).

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Kushanda kwechipatara kwakadzikama kuchikwata chese chekuchengeta
home_seo_description: Medora ichipatara chakawanda EMR yekunyoresa, kushanya, basa rekiriniki, kuverenga, uye kutonga. Imwe Soft Wash console yevaridzi, vashandi, uye pasi pekuchengeta.
home_hero_headline: Shandura mazuva echipatara ave kuyerera kwakadzikama, kwakabatana
home_hero_body: Medora: mabasa akawanda ekuchengetedza chipatara nekunyoresa, kushanya, mabhenji ebasa rekiriniki, uye heta mune imwe tenant console.
home_how_lead: Imwe inoyerera yekufamba-mukati uye yakabhukirirwa kutarisirwa. Yakagadzirirwa nguva zvikwata zvinofambisa varwere.
home_how_step1_body: Bata identity, allergies, uye nhoroondo kamwe. Kushanya kwega kwega kunozoshandisazve chati yakafanana.
home_how_step2_body: Gadzira OP kana IP kushanya, batanidza nguva dzekugadzwa, uye chengeta mamiriro ebazi akajeka pasi.
home_how_step3_body: Vanamukoti zvakakosha, kuongororwa, mirairo yemishonga, uye zvinyorwa zvinogara pane imwechete yekushanya nguva.
home_how_step4_body: Nyaya dzeInventory, kubhadharisa handoffs, uye nhanho dzekuburitsa zvinoramba zvakabatana nerekodhi yekushanya.
home_modules_lead: Mapaketi ekugona anovhara madhesiki anofanirwa kugara ari musync: hofisi yepamberi, kiriniki pasi, zvitoro, uye admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Mwoyo murefu tenzi, shanyira kusikwa, kugadzwa, uye nebazi-kuziva kutarisa-mukati.
home_modules_clinical_body: Nursing uye kubvunzana mamodule ane zvakakosha, kuongororwa, mirairo, uye EMR manotsi.
home_modules_inventory_body: Zvitoro, mabhechi, PR/PO/GRN, kushandiswa kwedhipatimendi, uye zviziviso zvemasheya.
home_modules_admin_body: Vashandi, mapazi, mapoka evashandisi, masters, zvinyorwa, uye chipatara setup.
home_model_heading: Imwe SaaS. Zvipatara zvakawanda. Mabasa akajeka.
home_model_lead: Medora ine-multi-hospital nedhizaini. Chikuva chinogadzira chipatara. Chipatara chinofambisa rubatsiro. Varwere havambodi hofisi yako yekumashure.
home_model_platform_body: Sisitimu inotonga varidzi vembeu, zvipatara, uye vanochengeta migove yega yega.
home_model_hospital_body: Varidzi nemaneja vanogadzira mapazi, zvitoro, kuwana kwevashandi, uye masters.
home_model_staff_body: Vanamukoti, vanachiremba, uye zvikwata zvezvitoro zvinoshanda kubva kumamodule-anoziva ari pasi.
home_model_patients_body: Machati, kushanya, uye magwaro zvinogara kuchipatara; vashandi vanoshanda kubva kune console.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Vitals, allergies, manotsi ehukoti, uye mabasa epamubhedha pasina kusiya kushanya.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Kuongororwa, mirairo yemishonga, uye zvinyorwa zvekiriniki zvedhesiki rechiremba.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Gamuchira, buritsa, chinjisa, uye odhita stock ine batch uye yekupera kuziva.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Vashandi, mapazi, mapoka ekuwana, zvinyorwa zvinyorwa, uye kugadzirisa.
home_integrated_heading: Chengetedza dhesiki rega rega pane imwe nguva yakatarwa
home_integrated_lead: Kugadzwa, mishonga, zvinyorwa, uye kufamba kwemasheya zvinogovera kushanya kuitira kuti pasi rirambe rakabatana.
home_cta_body: Saina kuMedora koni, sarudza chipatara, uye tanga kubva kumamodule ayo timu yako yatoshandisa.
home_footer_tagline: Kuvhiya kwechipatara kunyoreswa, kuchengetwa kwekiriniki, inventory, uye kutonga.
home_scene_aria: Wash yakapfava mufananidzo wechipatara chiri padivi pemiti muchivanze chakadzikama
pricing_seo_title: Menzies Medora pricing | Cloud uye On-premise
pricing_seo_description: Medora hospital EMR mitengo: Cloud kubva pa $99/mo (Starter to Platform). Pa-nzvimbo inoshandisa iwo matiyeri akafanana pamutengo weCloud + $150/mo yekuisa pane yako masisitimu. Kunyoresa, kiriniki, inventory, uye admin.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS kana On-nzvimbo pane yako masisitimu. Same Starter, Bhizinesi, Chikero, uye Platform tiers. Saizi yezvipatara nemamodule, kwete kushanya kwemamita kushushikana.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud inotambirwa Soft Wash Medora: Multi-hospital SaaS, yakagadziridzwa zvigadziriso, uye yakagovaniswa zvivakwa zvese saiti yaunomhanyisa.
pricing_lead_onprem: Pa-nzvimbo ndiyo yakafanana chigadzirwa tiers, yakaiswa uye kumisikidzwa pamaseva ako, dhatabhesi, uye network. Ndiwe muridzi wezvivakwa. Rondedzero yepamwedzi ndeye Cloud + ${premium} yebasa iroro.
pricing_lead_mmk: Kuratidza MMK pa1 USD = {rate} MMK yekuenzanisa kwenzvimbo.
pricing_lead_usd: USD nyora mitengo yezvikwata zvepasi rose.

pricing_who_lead: Platform, chipatara, vashandi, uye varwere mumwe nemumwe anowana nzira yakajeka. Sarudza Cloud kana On-premise, wobva wafanana tier inoenderana kuti zvingani zvipatara nemamodule aunomhanya.
pricing_who_platform_body: Vashandi vanodyara zvipatara zvakawanda uye vanoda chena-label plus SSO. Sarudza Platform pa Cloud kana On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Varidzi nemamaneja anogadzirisa mapazi, zvitoro, kuwana kwevashandi, uye masters. Bhizinesi kana Scale inokodzera akawanda akawanda-saiti mapoka.
pricing_who_staff_body: Vanamukoti, vanachiremba, uye zvikwata zvezvitoro pamamodule-anoziva mamodule. Seat limits scale nechirongwa; varwere havambooni kuseri kwehofisi.
pricing_who_patients_body: Machati, kushanya, uye zvinyorwa zvinogara kuchipatara. Vashandi vanoshanda kubva kuconsole mukati mekunyoresa kuburikidza nepedyo.
pricing_faq_a1: Matanho akatsikiswa ari paboka rechipatara rine chipatara nekepisi dzezvigaro. Cloud uye On-premise share Starter, Bhizinesi, Scale, uye Platform. Pa-nzvimbo yemwedzi rondedzero ndeye Cloud + $150. Hapana kana modhi inoshandisa meta-yekushanya iyo inosimuka pamazuva akabatikana.
pricing_faq_a2: Makiyi epagore ekubhadharisa mugore rinofungidzirwa reSoft Wash Medora. Chipatara cheLoomline-style SaaS kazhinji inoderedza zvirongwa zvegore nezve 15 kusvika 20%. Medora inoshandisa 20% kubva pachinyorwa chemwedzi paunobhadhara gore negore, kune ese Cloud uye On-nzvimbo (mushure me+$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Ko inventory uye kiriniki modules inosanganisirwa?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter inosanganisira kunyoreswa kwepakati, kushanya, uye mabhenji ebasa ekiriniki ane yekutanga hesita. Bhizinesi uye pamusoro kuvhura yakazara hesera yekufambisa, mishonga yemirairo yakabatana nestock, uye yakapfuma admin kumisikidzwa. Bvunza kana iwe uchida zvakadzorwa zvekuwedzera.
pricing_faq_a4: Shandisa musika wekushandura pamusoro pezvirongwa. Global inoratidza USD chete. Myanmar inoratidza MMK pa1 USD = 5000 MMK (ine USD semutsara wechipiri). Nguva yekubhadharira uye sevhisi maitiro akasiyana kubva pamusika.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud inotambirwa Soft Wash Medora: Multi-hospital SaaS, yakagadziridzwa zvigadziriso, uye nekukurumidza kutanga. Pa-nzvimbo inoshandisa iwo matairi akafanana, akaiswa pane yako masisitimu kana iwe uchida kutonga kana kugara. Infra ndeyako; rondedzero yepamwedzi ndeye Cloud + $150 yebasa iroro.
